versions.content: Definition of API function Com_Transmit Service Name Com_Transmit Syntax Std_ReturnType Com_Transmit ( PduIdType TxPduId, const PduInfoType * PduInfoPtr ) Service ID [hex] 0x51 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Reentrant for different TxPduIds. Non reentrant for the same TxPduId. TxPduId Identifier of the I-PDU to be transmitted. Parameters (in) PduInfoPtr Length of and pointer to the signal data and pointer to MetaData. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK : Transmit request has been accepted. COM_BUSY : Transmit request has been rejected due to minimum delay time violation. E_NOT_OK : Transmit request has not been accepted. Description Requests transmission of an I-PDU with Large Data Path. Available via Com.h
